CustomField.description: WHICH CLASS OF CALL THIS RECORD CONFIGURES: router, read, verify or match. Blank on the Default record, which is the fallback every class resolves through when no record names it. A RECORD per class rather than a FIELD per class, deliberately: the per-role fields on Default cover inventory, bind and verify and cover them by having been added one at a time, so the match call had no field at all and rode verify's. A new call class is a new RECORD an admin can add, never a schema change - which is also what makes this the surface BYOLLM lands on, since a customer registers their own models and names them here.
CustomField.label: Call Class
